name: custom-comment-highlighter
description: Highlight custom keywords anywhere in your code with configurable colors, flexible scope (comments or everywhere), and multiple display modes

customCommentHighlighter.keywords.description: Array of keywords to highlight with their corresponding colors. Each item should have 'keyword' (string) and 'color' (hex color code) properties.

keyword.description: The keyword(s) to highlight (case-sensitive). Can be a single string or an array of strings to apply the same style to multiple keywords.

fontColor.description: Font color in hex format (e.g., #FFFFFF). Defaults to white if not specified.

highlightMode.description: Highlight mode for this keyword: 'wholeLine' highlights the entire line, 'keywordOnly' highlights only the keyword. If not specified, uses the global highlightMode setting.
enumDescriptions: Highlight the entire line content (excluding trailing spaces)
Highlight only the keyword text itself

highlightScope.description: Highlight scope for this keyword: 'commentsOnly' highlights only in comments, 'everywhere' highlights throughout the file. If not specified, uses the global highlightScope setting.
enumDescriptions: Highlight keyword only when it appears in comments
Highlight keyword anywhere in the code

customCommentHighlighter.highlightMode.description: Highlight mode: 'wholeLine' highlights the entire line content (excluding trailing spaces), 'keywordOnly' highlights only the keyword text
enumDescriptions: Highlight the entire line content from first character to end (excluding trailing spaces)
Highlight only the keyword text itself

customCommentHighlighter.highlightScope.description: Scope of highlighting: 'commentsOnly' highlights keywords only in comments, 'everywhere' highlights keywords throughout the entire file
enumDescriptions: Highlight keywords only when they appear in comments
Highlight keywords anywhere in the code (comments, variables, strings, etc.)

scripts.compile: npm run check-types && npm run lint && node esbuild.js
scripts.package: npm run check-types && npm run lint && node esbuild.js --production
scripts.pretest: npm run compile-tests && npm run compile && npm run lint
